content:
I have successfully created the 11 Core Framework scripts for the Mini Kingdom project. The following files have been generated with the requested systems, namespaces, and documentation:

**Core Systems**
1. [GameManager.cs](file:///c:/Users/JCHJ/Desktop/Antigravity/mini-kingdom/Assets/Scripts/Core/GameManager.cs) - Handles global game states and run loops.
2. [EventBus.cs](file:///c:/Users/JCHJ/Desktop/Antigravity/mini-kingdom/Assets/Scripts/Core/EventBus.cs) - Thread-safe, generic pub/sub system.
3. [GameEvents.cs](file:///c:/Users/JCHJ/Desktop/Antigravity/mini-kingdom/Assets/Scripts/Core/GameEvents.cs) - Structs for all core system events.
4. [SaveManager.cs](file:///c:/Users/JCHJ/Desktop/Antigravity/mini-kingdom/Assets/Scripts/Core/SaveManager.cs) - JSON save loading and backing up.
5. [GameConfig.cs](file:///c:/Users/JCHJ/Desktop/Antigravity/mini-kingdom/Assets/Scripts/Core/GameConfig.cs) - ScriptableObject global configuration.
6. [DailyBonusSystem.cs](file:///c:/Users/JCHJ/Desktop/Antigravity/mini-kingdom/Assets/Scripts/Core/DailyBonusSystem.cs) - Controls the 5 daily bonus runs and 5 AM reset logic.
7. [RoyalDecreeSystem.cs](file:///c:/Users/JCHJ/Desktop/Antigravity/mini-kingdom/Assets/Scripts/Core/RoyalDecreeSystem.cs) - Handles daily royal decree generation and activation.

**Utilities**
8. [Singleton.cs](file:///c:/Users/JCHJ/Desktop/Antigravity/mini-kingdom/Assets/Scripts/Utils/Singleton.cs) - Reusable Generic Singleton MonoBehaviour.
9. [ObjectPool.cs](file:///c:/Users/JCHJ/Desktop/Antigravity/mini-kingdom/Assets/Scripts/Utils/ObjectPool.cs) - Auto-expanding Generic Object Pool.
10. [Extensions.cs](file:///c:/Users/JCHJ/Desktop/Antigravity/mini-kingdom/Assets/Scripts/Utils/Extensions.cs) - Convenient helper methods like `Shuffle` and `WeightedRandom`.
11. [WeightedRandomPicker.cs](file:///c:/Users/JCHJ/Desktop/Antigravity/mini-kingdom/Assets/Scripts/Utils/WeightedRandomPicker.cs) - Random selection structure for daily decrees and future features.

Please review and let me know if any further modifications are needed!
